feature.name: Infinite +1/+1 counters on most creatures you control

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Murderous Redcap enters, it and Celes trigger.
Resolve the Celes trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing damage to itself equal to its power.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawns die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C} {C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C} by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}. 
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.notes: If you control additional Squirrels, you can sacrifice them as well to get infinite Treasure tokens.

feature.name: Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Chatterfang by paying {B} and sacrificing another Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
Resolve all Chatterfang abilities, causing any number of target creatures to get +1/-1 until end of turn any number of times.

Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.

The token enters and dies as a 0/0.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Second Chance and take an extra turn.
Attack with Sun Titan, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
Opponents can not kill Sun Titan when you attack.
Sun Titan does not have summoning sickness.

feature.name: Infinite untap of legendary creatures you control
Infinite mana legendary creatures you control can produce

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Gogo triggers, causing it to become a copy of Ioreth until end of turn, and giving Gogo and Ioreth haste until end of turn.
Activate Gogo's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth and another legendary creature.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Gogo and another legendary creature.
Repeat from step 2.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one other legendary creature on the battlefield.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Glasspool Mimic's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Glasspool Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of General Leo Cristophe.
Repeat from step 2.

Repeat from step 2.

Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of General Leo Cristophe.
